inspections.violation_description: There were no new violations observed at the time of this inspection/visit.

General violation — correction required — At time of inspection child care service unable to document that all children enrolled have had an age appropriate medical evaluation.

Critical violation — must be corrected within 2 weeks — At time of inspection it was determined that child care service failed to ensure staff received required training within time frames and/or failed to maintain training records.
